rawRetro.summary: 修复轮：一次生产验证失败，四处缺陷其实同源——生产模式下 Workflow 运行模块被物化到 dist 之外的 storage，Node ESM 从模块位置向上找不到 node_modules，导致 `Cannot find package '@nocobase/db'`，流程全部 Error、请求停在 Pending、站内信未发出。把 Artifact 存储盘改到代码根目录内的 `workflow-artifacts` 后，两条请求端到端跑通，站内信与已读状态均通过真实数据库验证。

blockers.title: 生产构建下 Workflow 运行模块无法解析 @nocobase/* 裸导入
blockers.symptom: 工厂生产验证中「Register acceptance」节点报错；workflowRuns #1/#2/#3 状态均为 Error，service_requests 仍为 pending、result 为「—」，负责人与非负责人收件箱为空。同一流程在开发/源码模式（digest 82f0f9c1…）正常，生产构建模式（digest 7e37de02…）失败。
blockers.rootCause: 生产模式下 artifact-builder 把 `server/workflows` 的运行模块按原样复制进 dist/server/workflows，运行时再物化到 workflow.artifactDisk。模板默认 artifactDisk 为 `local`，其 location 是部署 storage 根（验证时为 /home/runner/work/_temp/repair-state/.../storage/private），位于代码根之外。运行模块以 ESM 方式加载，Node 从模块自身路径逐级向上查找 node_modules；storage 路径的祖先里没有任何包含 @nocobase/db 的 node_modules，于是导入失败。开发模式因 `!production` 时走 developmentResourceRoot（指向 app 内的 server/workflows）而掩盖了该问题。
blockers.resolution: 在 server/config/drive.ts 新增私有 fs 盘 `workflows`，location 为 paths.root('workflow-artifacts')（dev=应用根，prod=dist），server/config/workflow.ts 设 artifactDisk: 'workflows'。这样物化后的运行模块位于 dist 内，可经 dist/node_modules 解析裸导入；Artifact 属于代码派生状态、由 dist/server/workflows 在运行/重建时重新物化，因此放在构建目录而非业务存储中是正确归属。.gitignore 忽略源码根的 /workflow-artifacts/。新增 tests/logic/config.test.ts 断言该盘位于代码根内且 workflow.artifactDisk 指向它。
blockers.cost: 需要一次完整生产构建（约数分钟）+ 全新 state/config + db:apply + 启动生产服务做端到端验证；在确认前对 production=config.production||built 与 artifact-builder 不做 bundle 的机制做了较多源码走读。

improvements.title: Workflow Artifact 存储盘默认应落在代码根内
improvements.detail: 模板默认 artifactDisk 指向 storage 盘（部署 storage 根，在 dist 之外）。生产构建的运行模块从那里加载时无法解析 @nocobase/* 裸导入，开发模式却因 developmentResourceRoot 而正常，形成只在生产暴露的隐蔽缺陷。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在 create-app 的应用默认 server/config/drive.ts 与 workflow.ts 中，把 Workflow Artifact 盘默认放到 paths.root('workflow-artifacts') 并设 artifactDisk，使运行模块始终位于可解析 node_modules 的目录内；或让 @nocobase/app-plugin-workflow 的 artifact-store 在物化时确保模块可解析（如 bundle 运行模块或在 store 根放置指向 dist/node_modules 的解析入口）。

improvements.title: 基线自检应覆盖生产构建下的 Workflow 运行
improvements.detail: 纯单元测试用注入的假 services 直接 import 运行模块，无法发现生产物化路径导致的解析失败；只有真正以 NODE_ENV=production 运行构建产物并触发一次 Workflow 才能暴露。
improvements.suggestedChange: 在工厂验证中为「使用 Workflow 运行模块」的应用固定加入一次基于构建产物的端到端运行断言（触发后检查 workflow_runs 状态与通知落库），并让开发/生产两种模式各跑一次。

evaluation.summary: 本次需求的两条主线是 Workflow（登记受理 + 按紧急标记分支 + 执行记录）和 Notification/In-App 持久站内信（投递、收件人隔离、已读持久、点击打开请求）。Workflow DSL、条件分支、run 节点、trigger 服务、执行记录，以及 notification.send 的通道/幂等校验和 in-app 的数据库收件箱都直接支持需求；第二轮 QA B01-B04 全通过。主要障碍在 Workflow Artifact 的物化位置：runtime 以 ESM 从 artifact 目录动态 import run 模块，artifact 盘若不在代码根内，裸导入 @nocobase/db 在生产模式解析失败；插件/模板未提供安全默认或在启动/校验期 fail-fast，当前 Skill 也未记录 artifactDisk 需要代码根内可解析 node_modules。应用最终通过新增 workflow-artifacts 盘绕行并修复。

modules.name: Workflow DSL、条件分支与持久执行记录
modules.scope: defineWorkflow/RunInstruction/ConditionInstruction 的声明与分支编排、run 模块的命名导出与结果 schema、workflowServiceToken.trigger 的异步回执、以及 run/node 执行记录的持久化。
modules.limitations: 未运行应用，未独立重放执行记录；分支执行与 node-run 落库依据源码阅读和第二轮 QA 截图/报告，未直接读 engine 的调度实现。

requirements.need: 主管受理后由 Workflow 完成‘登记受理’，并据紧急标记走 normal/urgent 分支，执行记录可看到步骤与最终结果。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 DSL/指令抽象、DAG 分支执行、run 模块加载与结果契约、运行与节点记录的持久化；应用负责 workflow.ts 的编排和四个 run 模块的业务语义。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 server/workflows/<key>/workflow.ts 用 defineWorkflow 绑定 WorkflowSourceAst；RunInstruction.create 的 config.module 用扩展名省略的包内相对路径，声明 result schema；条件用 ConditionInstruction.branch；run 模块 export 名为 run 的函数并做 abort/幂等；业务侧 resolve(workflowServiceToken).trigger(key, input)。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用按此写 workflow.ts（registerAcceptance → routeByUrgency → markNormal/markUrgent → notifyAssignee），run 模块用 named run、declare result，并在 accept 路由中 trigger。第二轮 QA 运行 #1/#2 显示 Resolved，普通运行 normal 节点 Succeeded、紧急运行 urgent 节点 Succeeded 且 normal 节点 Not executed。

requirementFit.reason: 公开契约把 DSL、分支指令、run 结果 schema、异步 trigger 与执行记录分层提供，正好覆盖登记受理与普通/紧急分支；第二轮实测执行记录能区分两个分支。

usability.reason: declareWorkflow 的节点/result 声明与 run 模块命名导出约定一致，trigger 以 accepted/runId 回执返回，业务侧无需自建调度或执行表。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 给出明确任务路径、节点 description 强制、check CLI、trigger 示例与异步语义，Agent 能据此找到正确入口并完成 DSL 编排。

design.reason: DSL 源 AST、指令类、引擎与 Artifact loader 边界清晰；run 模块是普通命名导出函数，业务逻辑与框架流程解耦。

reliability.reason: 实现层对 run 模块做容器内路径校验、要求命名 run 导出、对不可 JSON 化的返回值显式报错，运行语义与 Skill 描述一致。

modules.name: Workflow Artifact 物化与生产运行时配置
modules.scope: WorkflowRuntimeConfig.artifactDisk 的解析、resolveWorkflowRuntimeConfig 对 distRoot/production 的计算、Artifact 盘的校验与 run 模块的运行时 import，以及已部署 revision 的 materialize/enable 入口。
modules.limitations: 快照未包含 create-app 模板源码，无法直接核对模板中 artifactDisk 的原始默认；模板默认值仅来自 retro 自述，插件/指南侧证据独立核对。

findings.title: Workflow Artifact 盘缺少代码根约束/校验，生产 run 模块在运行期才因裸导入失败
findings.detail: WorkflowRuntimeConfig.artifactDisk 是必填项，但 resolveWorkflowRuntimeConfig 只推导 distRoot/production，不推导或校验 Artifact 盘必须位于可解析 node_modules 的代码根内；createLocalWorkflowArtifactStore 也只校验 driver==='fs' 且 visibility==='private'。run 模块通过 pathToFileURL + 动态 import 从该盘加载，Node 按模块所在目录向上解析 '@nocobase/*'，因此盘落在部署 storage 根（代码根之外）时，开发模式因 developmentResourceRoot 而正常、生产模式第一次运行即抛 Cannot find package '@nocobase/db'。第一轮 QA 三条运行全部 Error、业务记录停在 Pending、站内信未发出。
findings.impact: 只使用 Workflow run 模块的应用在生产构建下核心路径不可用，且失败延迟到首次运行才暴露；本次需应用自行新增 code-root 盘并改 artifactDisk 才恢复。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 @nocobase/app-plugin-workflow 的 artifact-store/服务初始化时校验 Artifact 盘可解析宿主依赖（或在 store 根提供解析入口/打包 run 模块），并在配置解析处提供安全默认；同时在 Workflow Skill 写明 artifactDisk 必须位于代码根内。

findings.title: Workflow Skill 未记录 artifactDisk 与生产/开发 run 模块解析差异
findings.detail: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/SKILL.md 与 references/dsl-authoring.md 详述 DSL、check、Artifact build 与模块相对路径，但通篇没有 artifactDisk、代码根或 node_modules 解析约束；invocation-and-service-api.md 只讲管理 API/服务方法。Agent 无法从指南预知该生产陷阱，只能靠失败的生产 QA 反推。
findings.impact: 同一错误会在只使用 run 模块的应用中重复出现，增加一轮生产验证修复成本。
findings.suggestedChange: 在该 Skill 增加一小节：artifactDisk 必须指向代码根内（dist 内）的私有 fs 盘，run 模块以 ESM 从该位置解析 @nocobase/*，并给出 drive 盘 + config 的最小示例与自检方法。

findings.title: 已部署 Artifact 的 programmatic materialize/enable 无公开入口

指南要求 workflow.ts 绑定 WorkflowSourceAst、每个节点非空 description、run 模块命名导出并声明 result schema、先 workflow check、业务侧 resolve workflowServiceToken 调用 trigger、执行异步且 trigger 返回 accepted/skipped 回执。
evidence.excerpt:
- Keep one workflow package directly below the configured source root. Define invocation `inputSchema` separately from administrator `parameters`, and use stable, globally unique node keys.
- When updating an existing workflow's DSL (nodes, flow, configuration, or other definition fields), consider briefly noting what changed from the previous version and why in the workflow-level `description`. Preserve the workflow's purpose and replace any previous change note so only the latest update is described; see [top-level description guidance](references/dsl-authoring.md#top-level-definition).
- Bind the `defineWorkflow()` result to a `WorkflowSourceAst`-annotated const and default-export that const. A bare default-exported call does not pass the application's `isolatedDeclarations` build.
- Every node must have a non-empty `description`, including nodes in nested branches and custom Instructions. When creating or editing workflow orchestration, fill missing descriptions and keep them aligned with the node logic; follow the [node description guidance](references/dsl-authoring.md#topology-and-keys).
- Express sequencing with arrays and supported branches. Put executable work in typed `run` modules, use a named `run` export, and declare accurate result schemas for values referenced by later nodes.
- Run `pnpm nocobase workflow check <package>` before loading or publishing. It performs `typecheck`, `evaluate`, `schema`, `semantic`, and `compile` checks on `workflow.ts`; it does not validate run-script compilation or package resources. Add `--ir` to print the compiled flat IR, which is the definition an Artifact carries.
- A running development server compiles the workflow source root on demand and produces the same digest a build would, so an edited `workflow.ts` is already loadable there. Do not run a build merely to look at or exercise a definition in development; run one to produce a deployable Artifact.
- Validate run scripts and business behavior with target-application typecheck, tests, and build, then build the Workflow Artifact through the application's normal workflow build. Preserve package-relative resource paths. Artifact build, synchronization, enablement, and invocation are separate stages.
- Never author a source-managed workflow by directly editing materialized workflow tables.

# Invoke and Manage

- Business code resolves `workflowServiceToken` and calls `trigger(workflowKey, input, options?)`. The public service contract does not expose a management `run()` method or a generic public HTTP trigger endpoint.
- Use the authenticated management API for listing and inspecting definitions, enablement, parameter overrides, and authorized manual execution of a selected definition revision. A manual run may target a historical or disabled revision without changing its enablement.
- When source is available, use its directory key and `inputSchema` as the contract for new business-trigger code. In a deployed environment where only the management API is available, use runtime records for inspection and manual management; do not infer a new business trigger contract from a title or database id.
- `trigger()` returns either `skipped` with no event key or `accepted` with an event key after synchronous validation and scheduling succeed. Execution is asynchronous. Resolve the run by event key, and account for a concurrent duplicate call that can return the shared accepted identity before the first call finishes creating the run.
- An `eventKey` is optional and generated when omitted. Reuse the same stable key only when resubmitting the same business event whose acceptance is unknown; an existing run is deduplicated rather than re-executed. The public contract does not rerun a confirmed failed run by event key.

evidence.observation: 列出 check 的五阶段与不覆盖 run 脚本的事实；说明默认 app 的 Artifact build 在开发复制源码资源、生产收集 package-relative JS 输出而不再打包，运行期按 digest 物化 revision。全段未提 artifactDisk 位置约束。
evidence.excerpt:
The checker performs, in order:

1. `typecheck`: strict NodeNext TypeScript with the `source` export condition.
2. `evaluate`: a bounded disposable Node process loads the declarative TypeScript module and requires a valid default AST export.
3. `schema`: Input Schema, parameters, node config, condition expression, and result schemas.
4. `semantic`: registered types, unique/safe keys, branches, declared parameters, and visible result references.
5. `compile`: flat IR topology must have one start, one owner per non-start node, no missing targets, cycles, or unreachable nodes.

`check` does not scan the complete package or write the database. In particular, it does not prove that `config.module` exists or verify its named `run` export. It evaluates `workflow.ts` but does not load the run scripts. Do not publish/load after any issue. Error output contains phase, code, file/line where available, AST path, node key, and contract type; fix the earliest phase first because later phases depend on it.

The default app's Artifact build scans each direct Workflow package and writes immutable Artifacts to its configured dist root. In development it copies the package's source resources. In production the normal server TypeScript build runs first, and the Artifact build collects that package-relative JavaScript output without rebundling or renaming modules. Runtime module loading enforces containment and checks the named `run` export. Runtime loading materializes new revisions; activation and enablement are separate management concerns.

# Workflow

1. Read [Inbox Integration Contract](references/inbox-integration.md) for package requirements, public surfaces, and runtime semantics.
2. Inspect the target application's Server plugin list, Client composition, authentication setup, `api.baseURL`, `api.realtimeURL`, and installed package versions.
3. Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification` before `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/server` when the application needs the `in-app` Channel contribution.
4. Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client` in the Client composition root. In a development build, verify the page at `/dev/notification-in-app` relative to the App base path.
5. In React components and custom Hooks, use `useApiClient()` from `@nocobase/app-client` for inbox reads and mutations, and `useService(realtimeClientToken)` for subscriptions. Outside React, resolve the corresponding tokens from the application's services or receive the clients explicitly. Do not reconstruct `/api` from the browser location or Portal base.
6. Keep HTTP state authoritative. On a validated `inbox.changed` event, realtime connection open, or window focus, trigger a bounded HTTP refetch.
7. Use the public `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/realtime` entry for shared topic or event types; do not import Server internals.
8. Test allowed and denied users, CSRF-protected mutations, pagination, custom API hosts, realtime invalidation, reconnect recovery, and Dev Route registration.

evidence.excerpt:
## Final delivery validation

The database Provider checks the recipient through Authentication’s user administration service immediately before writing the inbox item. A missing user returns a non-retryable `recipient` failure and creates no inbox item or realtime event. A lookup failure remains a retryable storage failure. Custom hosts calling `createDatabaseProviderDefinition` must supply `recipientExists(userId)` backed by their authoritative user directory; do not use a permissive fallback.

## HTTP and realtime behavior

The authenticated inbox API is rooted at `notifications/in-app` relative to the injected `ApiClient` API base. Reads include list and unread-count. Writes include read/unread/delete and read-all, each preceded by an authenticated CSRF-token request.

For a custom host, register the exported `IN_APP_NOTIFICATION_NAMESPACE` and `inAppNotificationServerLocales` with its `I18nRuntime`, initialize the runtime, then mount its request i18n middleware before the inbox router. Notification-owned failures return a stable `error.code/message/ns/key/params` envelope; branch on `code`, display `message`, and use `ns`, `key`, and `params` only when the Client needs to retranslate it. Authentication middleware retains its owning plugin's error contract.

The WebSocket topic is user-scoped by the Server. An `inbox.changed` event does not carry authoritative inbox contents; it tells the UI to refetch HTTP state. The UI also refetches when the realtime connection opens so events missed during disconnection are recovered. Window focus is a fallback invalidation.

When an application configures `api.baseURL` or `api.realtimeURL`, both transports must use those injected client settings. Never derive the HTTP endpoint from `window.location`, a Portal base, or the WebSocket URL.

#### Ownership and upgrades

The plugin owns the inbox components, Provider, Dev Route, authentication enforcement, per-user isolation, CSRF, persistence, and event publication. Applications receive UI changes by upgrading the plugin. A production inbox surface requires a separate product decision and must use an authenticated App or Settings Route rather than exposing the Dev Route.

## Diagnosis order

1. Confirm the authenticated list and unread-count endpoints return the expected durable state.
2. Confirm mutations fetch a CSRF token and return the changed item/count.
3. Confirm the application client points HTTP and realtime transports at the intended backend.
4. Confirm the realtime connection subscribes to the public topic.
5. Confirm a valid invalidation increments the UI revision and triggers an HTTP refetch.
6. Confirm reopening the realtime connection refetches even when no event was received.
7. Confirm cleanup removes the topic, connection-open, and window-focus listeners.

Do not diagnose a missing UI update by manually changing the inbox table or publishing synthetic production events. Reproduce with an isolated test notification or inspect the durable route and subscription logs.

Configure `notification.channels.inbox: { provider: 'in-app' }` and send `messages: { inbox: { to: 'user-id', title: 'Title', body: 'Body' } }`. Channel keys are names; multiple names using `in-app` are independent targets. `to` requires an application user ID or a non-empty readonly array, with one Delivery per user. No current user is inferred. The test form requires an explicit recipient.

Use `target: { type: 'route', path: '/topics/123' }` for an internal route without the deployment prefix, or `target: { type: 'url', url: 'https://example.com/main/topics/123' }` for a complete HTTP(S) URL. The inbox adds the Router basename only for routes. Without a target, no Open link is shown. Legacy `actionUrl` is ignored; run the new target-column migration without converting old links.
